simple.meaning: חֲמֹרָה (chămôrâh) is a Hebrew word meaning “a heap.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: חֲמֹרָה (H2565) appears 2 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Judges 15:16, with occurrences in Judges.

simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in חֲמֹרָה (H2565) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: חֲמֹרָה (chămôrâh) / H2565 is traced through Judges 15:16 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.
